proposal.title: Kajenn Press administration as a site editor
proposal.author: Giovanni Porcari

problem.p: Kajenn Press must become the tool used to create and edit sites interactively. An author writes a Gramlot template, sees the rendered page next to the editor, and edits contents and CSS from the administration with Gramlot editors.

The administration today is mostly a browser. Its only editing workspace supports one template shape: one required HTML block named body. A site built with other blocks, such as the Kajenn Press presentation site with hero and body, can be edited only through MCP or REST.
The rendered preview shows saved revisions only, and without the CSS and images of the site.

current.fact: The administration shell is an IndexPage with a site selector in the top bar, a navigation tree on the left and retained iframe tabs in the center.
The authoring page declares BLOCKS = {"body": {"format": "html", "required": True}} and refuses templates whose blocks differ, with the message at line 107.
The authoring page shows the result of render_preview in an htmlPreview.
render_preview takes a variant_id and an exact saved revision_id: unsaved edits cannot be rendered.
Resource URLs in Data default to /_resources/<sha256>.<suffix>; freeze accepts a resource_urls override (line 22).
htmlPreview renders its value through srcdoc in an iframe with sandbox="" and has no zoom parameter.
The administration CSP allows style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' and img-src 'self' data:.
The login view and the top bar still show the former name "kajenn public site"; the login has no logo.
current.p: A sandboxed iframe without allow-same-origin has an opaque origin, so /_resources/ URLs and session cookies cannot serve the preview. This follows from the HTML specification and was not tested in the administration.
current.limit: Publication from the administration is a later phase; build, activation and rollback are available through MCP and REST only.

section.title: Shell and navigation
section.p: The shell stays an IndexPage. Each opened object gets its own retained tab: a page, a template, a stylesheet, a script or a media item.

row.cell: Kajenn Press logo at 48 px with the text name, site selector, New site, account and Sign out
Navigation tree of the current site: Pages, Templates, Styles, Scripts, Media, Publishing; then Shared library and Deployments
One retained tab per opened object, closable
Status: save state of the active tab and permissions in the current scope

section.p: Each tree group lists its records. Selecting a record opens its editor tab, or selects the tab when it is already open. A New command in each group creates a record of that kind.
section.rule: Behaviour uses Source, Data, bindings and components; no imperative DOM manipulation.

section.title: Login and identity
section.p: The login card shows the Kajenn Press logo, assets/kajenn-press/logo/kajenn-press-256.png displayed at 160 px, the minimum size for the full logo in the identity guide. Labels "kajenn public site" become "Kajenn Press".
section.rule: The logo is never cropped, rotated, stretched, shadowed or recoloured.

section.title: Page editor
section.p: The page editor opens one language variant.

list.item: Toolbar: Save draft, Revert, Revisions, Open template, Readiness.
Left pane: one tab per block declared by the template. HTML blocks offer Jodit (htmlEditor) and the source (codeMirror, html). Markdown blocks offer markdownEditor and the source.
Right pane: the scaled preview. A splitter separates the panes.

section.p: This removes the single-block limit of the current authoring page.

list.item: Templates, CSS and JavaScript open in codeMirror with their language. Cmd+S saves a new revision.
Next to the code, the preview renders a sample page of the site with the resource being edited.
A template also shows a form for its block declarations and its dependencies.
Media show upload and a view of the file.

section.title: Live preview
section.p: A new operation, render_draft, renders unsaved sources. It receives the variant and, optionally, unsaved block sources and unsaved resource sources that replace their saved revisions for this render. It freezes the inputs, runs the worker and returns HTML and diagnostics. It writes nothing to the catalog.
section.rule: render_draft requires the same permissions as render_preview: build and read on the site, read and use on the resources.
section.p: The editor calls render_draft about 800 ms after the last edit. A newer call replaces an older one.
For the preview, freeze receives resource_urls with data: URLs of the exact resource bytes, so CSS and images load inside the sandboxed iframe. The administration CSP adds data: to style-src.
The preview renders the page at a fixed width, 1280 px or 375 px, inside a container scaled with transform: scale(). A selector offers 0.5, 0.75 and 1.
section.diagram: sequenceDiagram participant Editor as Editor tab participant Admin as Admin endpoint participant Service as Render service participant Worker as Render worker Editor->>Admin: render_draft(variant, unsaved sources) Admin->>Service: freeze with overrides and data: URLs Service->>Worker: frozen inputs Worker-->>Service: HTML and diagnostics Service-->>Admin: result, catalog unchanged Admin-->>Editor: HTML into the scaled preview

list.item: Shell, login and navigation: logo, names, navigation tree, one tab per object, status bar.
Preview infrastructure: render_draft on REST and MCP, data: resource URLs, data: in the administration style-src, scaled preview container.
Page editor with all declared blocks and the live preview.
Resource editor for templates, CSS, JavaScript and media with the live preview.
Publishing panel: candidate, build, preview grant, activation and rollback.

decision.question: How does the preview show unsaved edits?

option.title: New render_draft operation
option.p: Renders unsaved sources without writing to the catalog.

option.title: Save on every edit
option.p: Every save creates an immutable revision.

decision.question: Which shell hosts the editors?

option.title: IndexPage with one tab per object
Gramlot IdePage
option.p: Built on a filesystem tree, not on catalog records.

decision.choice: The current shell already uses it.

decision.question: How do CSS and media reach the sandboxed preview?

option.title: Admin endpoint serving resource revisions
option.p: The opaque origin of the sandboxed iframe sends no session cookie.

decision.choice: Needs no new endpoint and no cookie.

decision.question: How is a data: stylesheet admitted by the administration CSP, which allows style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' only?

option.title: Add data: to style-src
option.p: One change in src/kajenn_press/admin/host.py; templates keep their link elements.

option.title: Inline the stylesheet in the preview
option.p: The preview rewrites each stylesheet link into a style element; the rendered HTML differs from the release.

decision.choice: The preview keeps the same HTML as the release.

consequences.p: Implemented in kajenn-org/kajenn-press#5. Superseded on 2026-10-27 by , which replaces its navigation, editors and publishing panel.
Each render_draft call starts a worker process, with the configured timeout of 15 seconds by default. The delay of about 800 ms limits the calls while typing.
The data: URLs enlarge the preview HTML by the size of the CSS and media of the page, up to the existing input limit of 32 MiB.
The current authoring page and the browse pages are replaced by the new editors.
